data.headline: Head of Mobile at Touch Surgery
data.about:
My journey through iOS development began at the University of Hull and took me to a Lead Developer role at a London agency, Future Workshops. There I learnt that Apps can be beautiful inside and out, and this beauty is reflected in ease of use as much as aesthetics. I have spent half a year working at ThoughtWorks bringing my specialist experience to the team while gaining generalist technical skills and learning consultancy practices. Over the last two years I have been working remotely for LoveCrafts and seek to continue remote working.
I have developed a number of world class Apps such as Shazam and Time Out as part of larger teams, or leading teams making Apps like toptable (Now OpenTable) and Apps for enterprise clients. One of my most recent Apps is LoveKnitting, a regular headliner in the Lifestyle category.
Doing agency work has provided me with the chance to develop my skills in a variety of directions including public speaking, client relations, usability testing, and developer management. In my spare time, I play Ultimate Frisbee nationally, as captain and treasurer for different teams.

description.text:

annotations, sketches, and bespoke tools to keep track of where they are in the pattern
· Designed custom eventually synchronised offline use capability
· Used TDD and functional RX concepts with Swift
· Continuously improved our project workflow
· Transitioned the iOS team from office based to full time remote

· Performed usability testing and user research in order to refine the product
· White labelled the App for multiple Apps with single codebase

cross discipline team

myself
· Led team based projects with up to 3 other developers, QA, and designer
